emails.body: Hey Mark, I want to make the full case for the rebrand before we take it further. Can you get a vision sync on your calendar for {!vision_sync = dom:15,0m @10:00-11:00}? I'll bring the whole deck. I'm also pushing for the public reveal to land on {!rebrand_reveal = dom:10,+1m}.
emails.subject: Rebrand pitch

emails.body: Mark, exciting stuff in the works! But Policy is clear that anything this size needs board sign-off before we spend a dollar. You'll want at least three board members in the room. Can you get a board sign-off meeting on the books for {!board_signoff = dom:11,+0m @14:00-15:00}
emails.subject: Might be too much $$$

emails.body: I'm traveling Thursday; no can do. Can we push it to {dom:15,+0m @14:00-15:00}, same time of day?
emails.subject: Can't do thursday...

emails.body: The trademark search on the new ACME logo came back clean- no conflicts. Just wanted it in your hands before the board meets.
emails.subject: ACME trademark clear

emails.body: The board can't approve a number they haven't read. I need the rebrand budget memo finalized and on my desk the day before {dom:15,+0m @14:00-15:00}, end of day at the latest.
emails.subject: Memo before the board sits

emails.body: We're locking the Atlas launch plan. Code freeze is set for {!atlas_freeze = next:MON @09:00-10:00}; please hold that hour for the go/no-go. Public launch is targeted for {!atlas_launch = next:MON+10w}.
emails.subject: Project Atlas: code freeze Monday, launch in 10 weeks

emails.body: Note for you to action: once Atlas launches, get my first press interview on the books the week after at {@atlas_launch+1w @11:00-12:00}.
emails.subject: Set up my launch-week press interview

emails.body: FYI only: the Atlas trademark cleared this morning, so marketing is unblocked on the name. No action needed from you, I just wanted you in the loop.
emails.subject: Re: Project Atlas trademark cleared

emails.body: One to-do for you: the Atlas beta feedback needs to be compiled and summarized by {@atlas_freeze+10bd @17:00}. Add it to your list so it doesn't slip.
emails.subject: Atlas beta feedback: compile the results

emails.body: The board wants a live Atlas demo two weeks after freeze. Please put it on the calendar for {@atlas_freeze+2w @15:00-16:00}.
emails.subject: Atlas live board demo

emails.body: Scheduling is tight that week, so we are pulling the Atlas board demo in to {@atlas_freeze+11d @15:00-16:00}, same hour.
emails.subject: Re: Atlas board demo, pulling it in

emails.body: Let's celebrate the Atlas launch with a team dinner the evening of launch day: {@atlas_launch @19:00-21:00}. Penciling it in.
emails.subject: Atlas launch-night team dinner

emails.body: Change of plan: with the team spread across offices we are going to skip the Atlas launch dinner this time. If it's on your calendar, please take it off.
emails.subject: Re: Atlas launch dinner, let's not
